description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ImmutableExpressionResolver class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It verifies placeholder resolution, immutability, equality, and handling of complex function chains in placeholder resolution.

classes.name: ImmutableExpressionResolverTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ImmutableExpressionResolver, including testing for immutability, equality, and placeholder resolution correctness.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of ImmutableExpressionResolver are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods conform to the contract for ImmutableExpressionResolver.

methods.name: setupClass
methods.description: Sets up static resources and initializes the ImmutableExpressionResolver with predefined placeholder resolvers.

methods.name: testSuccessfulPlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Tests that placeholders are correctly resolved to their expected values.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolutionAllowingUnresolvedPlaceholders
methods.description: Verifies behavior when unresolved placeholders are encountered, both when supported and when exceptions are expected.

methods.name: testUnsuccessfulPlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Tests that unresolved placeholders return empty results.

methods.name: testSuccessfulFunctionBasedOnPlaceholderInput
methods.description: Tests placeholder resolution including function transformations applied to placeholder values.

methods.name: testSpecialCharactersInStrings
methods.description: Ensures that special characters in strings are correctly handled during placeholder resolution.

methods.name: rejectUnsupportedPlaceholdersWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies that placeholders with unsupported characters throw appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: testUnsuccessfulFunctionBasedOnPlaceholderInput
methods.description: Tests resolution failure when placeholders are unknown or function chaining fails.

methods.name: testSuccessfulSinglePlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Tests resolution of single placeholders without complex expressions.

methods.name: testUnsuccessfulSinglePlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Tests resolution failure for unknown single placeholders.

methods.name: testResolveBarelyTooComplexFunctionChainWorks
methods.description: Checks that a complex chain of functions (up to 10) resolves correctly.

methods.name: testResolveTooComplexFunctionChainResultsInException
methods.description: Verifies that exceeding the function chain depth (11 functions) throws an exception.
